    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    return [[mark if v == bg else 3 for v in row] for row in left]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separate the two panels.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        lb = max(set(v for row in left for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in left))
        rb = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in right))
        out = []
        for a, b in zip(left, right):
            out.append([3 if a[j] != lb and b[j] != rb else lb for j in range(n)])
        return out

    top = grid[:sep_row]
    bg = max(set(v for row in top for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in top))
    return [[3 if v != bg else 7 for v in row] for row in top]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Use the panel before the solid divider. Its sparse non-background
    # marks become 3, while the panel background becomes 8.
    col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if col is not None:
        panel = [row[:col] for row in grid]
    else:
        row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        panel = grid[:row]

    values = [v for line in panel for v in line]
    bg = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    return [[8 if v == bg else 3 for v in line] for line in panel]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = next(v for v in set(sum(left, [])) if v in set(sum(right, [])))
    bg = next(v for v in set(sum(left, [])) if v != common and
              sum(row.count(v) for row in left) > sum(row.count(common) for row in left))
    return [[3 if a == common and b == common else bg
             for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(left, right)]
